# GoalOracle

> Free FIFA World Cup 2026 prediction game. Users build brackets in two modes — Quick Picks (rank the four teams in each group, select the eight best third-placed teams, then fill the knockout bracket) and Classic Predictions (score + result for every fixture). Players join public or private leagues and compete on a global leaderboard. 100% free, no gambling, no entry fees, no real-money prizes. Prediction engine is compliant with the official FIFA World Cup 26 rulebook (including Annexe C third-place routing across all 495 combinations).

## Key facts

- **URL:** https://goaloracle.io
- **Tournament:** FIFA World Cup 2026
- **Kickoff:** 11 June 2026, 15:00 ET
- **Final:** 19 July 2026
- **Hosts:** United States, Canada, Mexico
- **Matches:** 104 total across Group Stage, Round of 32, Round of 16, Quarterfinals, Semifinals, and Final
- **Cost:** Free. No entry fees, no prize money, no wagering, no gambling.
- **Modes:**
  - **Quick Picks** — guided three-step wizard (rank groups, pick best thirds, fill bracket). ~10 minutes. 76 total points (36 group stage + 8 best thirds + 32 knockouts).
  - **Classic Predictions** — predict score and result for every one of the 104 matches. 3 pts for correct result, 5 pts for exact score, +1 extra time bonus, +2 penalty bonus. League creators can customize point values.
- **Result verification:** Dual-source oracle. Results are pulled from football-data.org and api-football.com, and both sources must agree before points are awarded. Disputes trigger admin review.
- **Authentication:** Email, Google, Twitter/X, or wallet (via Privy). An embedded wallet is created at signup for future features; no funds are collected.
- **Leagues:** Public (listed, open to all), private (invite-only with passcode), or scoped (specific groups or rounds only).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://goaloracle.io/): Hero, next-match countdown, how it works, scoring breakdown, social proof.
- [FAQ](https://goaloracle.io/faq): How the game works, leagues and privacy, score verification methodology, gambling policy, account support.
- [How it works](https://goaloracle.io/how-it-works): Step-by-step introduction to both prediction modes.
- [Leaderboard](https://goaloracle.io/leaderboard): Global Quick Picks and Classic Predictions standings.
